items.heading: Asado
details: Key ingredients: beef ribs, sausages, chimichurri, salt
Season various cuts of beef and sausage simply with coarse salt.
Grill slowly over wood or charcoal embers at a moderate distance.
Turn occasionally, cooking low and slow until deeply browned and tender.
Serve sliced with fresh chimichurri sauce on the side.

items.heading: Empanadas
details: Key ingredients: flour dough, ground beef, onion, boiled egg, cumin
Saute ground beef with onion, cumin and paprika, then cool the filling.
Mix in chopped boiled egg and a few olives.
Fill dough rounds with the mixture and crimp the edges shut.
Bake or fry until golden and crisp.
